title: feat: separate official and community models
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Separates the model catalog into Official and Community scopes, with Official as the default.
- Limits Community filters to All, Text, and Image while keeping one contextual search.
- Preserves search queries across scopes and resets incompatible modality filters.
- Uses the large Package UI scope controls introduced by #13141.

Stacked on #13141; merge the Package UI PR first.

Checks:
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npx vitest run test/model-categories.test.ts`
- Verified locally and on [staging](https://staging.enter.pollinations.ai/models)

gist.headline: Two gardens, one search
gist.blurb: The model garden now has two paths: Official models up front, Community models nearby. Polli kept the search basket intact while moving between them, because losing a good query is how software becomes haunted.
gist.summary: The model catalog now separates Official and Community scopes, opens on Official by default, keeps a shared search query across both, and limits Community filtering to All, Text, and Image.
gist.impact: Users can find supported models more directly while still browsing community offerings, with incompatible modality filters reset cleanly when switching scopes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the model catalog as a cozy garden split into two clearly labeled paths: a tidy Official greenhouse and a friendly Community flower patch. Polli wears a tiny librarian hat and carries one search magnifying glass between the paths, while a retro terminal keeps the same glowing search query visible; small Text and Image seed packets represent the Community filter options.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art model garden with two large package-style signposts, "OFFICIAL" above a neat greenhouse and "COMMUNITY" above a flower-filled patch, connected by one glowing search bar; the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny librarian hat and carrying a magnifying glass as she moves between the paths. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and Text/Image seed packets, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
